about: The root-cause clusters of the accessibility findings ledger (lib/a11y-issues.mjs; tests/AGENTS.md, A11y: the findings ledger and the cluster catalog). A cluster has id, title, an optional tracker (a task id, or a list of them; code, never printed on the page) and match rules: source, then any of checks, kinds, rules, causes, criteria, pages, themes, where, axeIssues. Values in a field are ORed, fields in a rule ANDed, rules in a cluster ORed. A where pattern reads the finding's masked selector, its step, or both joined as '<masked selector> @ <step>'. A finding no rule matches lands in needs-triage; one that two rules match fails lib/__tests__/a11y-issues.test.mjs. triageLimit is the exact number of sampled finding shapes that need triage: lowered when a shape is sorted into a cluster, raised only visibly, in the change that adds one, and every shape left there has its reason in that test's TRIAGE_REASONS.

clusters.title: The overlay clones split the accessibility tree: the column headers read after the data, each row is exposed twice, the row headers sit apart from their rows, and a screen reader loses the cell's row index
Reading mode skips a row at the edge of the rendered band of a long grid (A5 of 200 rows), on every reader but NVDA with Chromium
In reading mode NVDA with Chromium stops on an empty item (`blank`) right before the grid, so the reading cursor reaches nothing where the table should start
With Chromium a jump to a row the grid renders only once it scrolls there (Ctrl+ArrowDown to the last of 200 rows) is not announced
The grid is built from divs with ARIA roles, and its treegrid root holds children the role does not allow

The focus is not returned to the cell after Escape, Enter, Tab or a shortcut closes an editor, a menu or the comment editor: it stays on the closed editor's field or falls to the document, and a screen reader does not announce the cell

An editor's list does not announce the choice the keys reach: with Chromium the autocomplete and dropdown options that aria-activedescendant names have no name, a narrowed list and its highlighted choice are silent on every reader, and the handsontable editor exposes no highlighted row at all
The autocomplete and dropdown editors put the combobox role on a textarea, which ARIA in HTML does not allow, and name a closed list in aria-controls that axe cannot find

VoiceOver with WebKit reads a text field the focus moves to inside the grid, a menu or the sheets bar by its value or label alone, without its role (the cell editors, the filter inputs, the sheet rename field), where it names the role of a field outside them

Controls without an accessible name or role: the editor inputs, the native date and time inputs, the select editor, the comment textarea, the filter condition select and the filter listbox, the autocomplete list, and the focus catchers

The empty data state's message, for no data and for loading, takes the focus as a div with no role, so NVDA with Firefox reads `section` without its text and VoiceOver with WebKit reads its title alone
A sheet tab being renamed keeps its tab stop after it drops its button role, so the focus order holds a div with no role beside the name field
The formula builder's editor puts the combobox role on a textarea with aria-controls naming a closed list, and its function help panel takes the focus as a div with no role that Tab does not leave
Tab in the formula editor accepts the highlighted suggestion and keeps the focus in the editor, as the formula builder intends: the keyboard walker reads it as a Tab that stays

Menu items have no menu parent, the highlighted item carries aria-selected, separators are exposed as menu items, and a screen reader hears the context and column menus as a table, NVDA without the word menu

A checkbox in a cell or a header does not announce its state: the focus stays on the cell, so the mixed state of the check all and select all checkboxes and a row header checkbox's state are never read, the corner reads its own name over the select all checkbox, and Space toggling one is silent with Chromium
A read-only cell is not announced as read only: the cell carries aria-readonly, which no reader says when the focus reaches it
A link in a cell is not announced as a link: the focus stays on the cell, whose name is its text, and the link inside never takes the focus, so NVDA reads the address and never says link
What a plugin marks on a cell with a class alone is not announced: a commented cell and a column summary cell read as plain cells, the read-only summary without its read-only state
A merged cell's span is not read by NVDA with Firefox or by VoiceOver, though the cell carries rowspan and colspan: only NVDA with Chromium says `through row 3 column 3`
The accessible name of the Filters "Filter by value" component does not include its visible text
The Filters "Select all" and "Select none" controls are buttons nested inside buttons
Text, icon, checkbox, grid line and focus indicator contrast under 4.5:1 or 3:1 per theme, and a focus indicator that does not show
Drags without a single-pointer or keyboard alternative that does all the drag does, and controls that act on the press or after the pointer left

Content cut off or needing a sideways scroll at 320 px or 200 %, hover content that does not dismiss, controls drawn over each other, a locked orientation, and motion that runs on or ignores the reduced-motion preference
In forced colors the focus, the selected range, the highlighted menu item, the header icons or the grid lines are not drawn
A range extension, Ctrl+A selecting every cell, a sort and a nested row's level are not announced: no status message reaches the screen reader

A load that starts or ends without a focus move is not announced: a sheet switch that starts a server fetch (the loading message is no live region), and a pending cell's value that arrives (with Chromium)
A pending or failed cell's visually hidden status text follows its value with no space between them, so VoiceOver with WebKit reads the two as one word (`Old BLoading...`) and neither on its own

VoiceOver does not read a freeze bar's frozen count: the bars carry aria-valuenow over a range and no aria-valuetext (left out for want of a plural form per language), so a move reads as a percentage and a focus as a splitter without its count
axe's experimental focus-order-semantics rule lists the freeze bars for review: a focusable separator is the window splitter pattern, which the rule does not take as a widget
Tab walks out of an open modal dialog to the content behind it, which the dialog hides from assistive technology
Pagination and sheets bar buttons, links and checkboxes are smaller than 24 by 24 px, or sit closer than that to their neighbors

VoiceOver names no row number on a cell move, no column number in WebKit and no header role on a header, on a well-formed grid too: the screen reader's behavior, not the grid's (the scenario notes record it)

A screen reader says nothing on a step whose surface it reads on later steps or in other runs: VoiceOver on the first key after the runner enters the page above all, on cells, headers, menus, editors and page buttons alike, which points at the reader's start-up, not at the surface

An announcement or an accessibility tree differs from its golden with no defect behind it: reader wording that varies between runs, a reading golden recorded a phrase late, and goldens older than an intended change (the dropdown editor opens with no choice highlighted); record the golden again

A screen reader scenario expected what the grid no longer does on purpose: the dropdown editor opens with no choice highlighted when the cell's value equals none of its choices, so the scenario's later choices were one step off; the scenario is fixed, and these rows resolve on the next audit
With autoWrapRow a Tab walk wraps rows and leaves the grid through Ctrl+End then Tab, as the shortcut guide documents
A page has no tab-order or accessibility-tree golden recorded yet
Column headers with no accessible name: the corner and the empty header cells label their cells with nothing
axe's experimental hidden-content rule lists every hidden element for review: the overlay clones' hidden rows, the closed editors and menus
The scrolling holder is not keyboard focusable, though every cell in it is: axe cannot tell and lists it for review
The docs header's "Ask AI" button has an accessible name that does not contain its visible text
The docs framework switcher's tabs have accessible names that do not contain their visible text
An off-screen copy of the docs navigation is hidden from screen readers but still holds focusable links
Links in the docs prose are told apart from the surrounding text by color alone
Docs code block line numbers in the dark theme, and cell text in some examples, fall below 4.5:1 contrast
Scrollable code blocks and tables in the docs cannot be scrolled from the keyboard
Docs embeds have no frame title, custom renderer images have no text alternative, and some example fields have no label
